purpose: test a denser exact-source schedule with bounded temporal-neighbor moving warps, reducing per-query direct repair while preserving z-buffer visibility

source_references.moving_selection: always include the two exact keyframes bracketing the saved query; choose the remaining three by nearest source timestamp
source_references.states: only already logged physical/robot state rows; no synthetic trajectory samples

geometry.static_labels: reuse observed fixed-camera pixels and depth from all nine exact source views
geometry.moving_labels: project selected source samples using source-link to interpolated target-link SE3, then rasterize same-label continuous surface triangles
geometry.visibility: per-pixel nearest interpolated depth across dynamic source surfaces and observed static background; ties remain unsupported
geometry.moving_edge_guard_rule: pixels adjacent to projected moving-front evidence remain unsupported until repaired by exact camera rendering
geometry.unobserved_or_ambiguous: remain explicit exact-render requests; no inpainting or sensor-threshold changes

radiometry.temporal_interpolation: log-domain interpolation between observations of the same frontmost label and depth
radiometry.single_sided_observation: hold nearest observed source sample and report separately

evaluation.queries: all exact saved state rows in the same 40 ms window
evaluation.direct_roi_repair: exact projection, limited to explicit request pixels; crop configuration is development-specific
evaluation.occlusion_audit: compare per-pixel dynamic-front labels, missing/false occlusion, and depth against exact full-frame direct render
evaluation.old_checkpoints: diagnostic only; trained on prior event-generation domain
